phrase: traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal
note: Original camera review, officer identity, Native direction readback, ego-entry timing and authority source must be joined; a programmed gesture or visible person alone does not establish police control.

sweep_dimensions.description: active stop/go, active hold, inactive presence or absent officer
